set.body:
Outcome

Use Alder from an immutable clean revision without making it part of the shared evidence or relational core.

Acceptance

- ScalaFIM JVM and Scala.js consumers exercise data roles, Resample4s exact-once binding, preparation, learner, scoring, selection, and receipt paths.
- Snapshot, local-composite, and remote-pin evidence are distinguished.
- Alder types remain confined to the predictive compiler and public predictive workflow surface where intentional.
- No local reimplementation of Alder lifecycle policy is added.
set.title: P4A.1: pin and rehearse the Alder predictive lifecycle boundary
